finding.scope: (g,n)=(6,6) over C with Q-coefficients; the FND-0167 setup with S of dimension 15, A of dimension 17, Delta of dimension 16.
finding.statement: Refuting the base corner does not refute the Z-clause, and the campaign's repair should not assume it does. FND-0167's corner map is an INJECTION Gr^W_16 H_c^16(U;Q) -> Gr^W_16 H_c^16(S;Q) direct-sum Gr^W_14 H_c^14(S;Q)(-1) direct-sum Gr^W_12 H_c^12(S;Q)(-2), which propagates Tate-ness downward but cannot propagate non-Tate-ness from S to U or to Z=Ord(U). The dimension route also stalls: over a 15-dimensional S the Abel-Jacobi bundle A=P_S(pi_*L) has dimension 17 and the non-reduced-divisor locus Delta = A minus U has dimension 16, so F^15 H_c^16(Delta;C) need not vanish and the FND-0165 localization gives no lift from A to U. Hence Gr^W_16 H_c^16(Z;Q) remains open, and the correct repair of the C66-TATE-SUPPORT statement is to drop the universally quantified base/universal-curve conjunct, name the atlas on which (H-S)/(H-C) are asserted, and prove the Z-corner directly or conditionally on that named atlas.
